variants.prompt: Against the harsh neon lights of a late-night club, the young woman stands in a provocative pose, her threadbare band tee pulled taut across her chest as she leans back against the wall. The scuffed combat boots and ripped denim of her outfit seem almost surreal against the electric blue backdrop, as does her bold, unapologetic expression. The shallow depth of field blurs the chaotic crowd into a colorful haze, focusing attention solely on her striking green eyes and the defiant set of her jaw.
